en.focal: Renew early to take the pressure off
en.alt: Decision diagram: did you send your passport in? Yes - wait for the new one before travelling abroad. No - is it still valid for your trip? Then check your destination's entry rules. Renew early to take the pressure off
en.caption: Travel during renewal depends on the application route and whether your passport remains valid and available.
